# Catalog schemas

JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12) for each record type in [`catalog/`](../catalog/README.md). They document the contract; [`scripts/validate_catalog.py`](../scripts/validate_catalog.py) enforces it in CI without external dependencies.

## OSINTAI Curated Collection Entry

File: [`collection.schema.json`](collection.schema.json)

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `id` | string | ✔ | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| `name` | string | ✔ | not empty |
| `url` | string | ✔ | uri format |
| `status` | enum | ✔ | one of `verified`, `candidate`, `archival`, `rejected` |
| `focus` | list of string | ✔ | at least 1 item |
| `notes` | string |  | — |

<sub>No fields beyond these are allowed.</sub>
